sources: audit/state_park_fees/co_sites_2026-10-12.jsonl + co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop parkID 50039 per-site catalog and 2027-06 rates)

values.note: Sites 200-280 in the F and G loops, all full hookups; ADA sites 236 and 280. Booking-site lengths 38-90 ft, mostly pull-throughs. Walk-in tent sites 281-295 (H loop) are tents only.

sites.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging ('the Pa-Co-Chu-Puk campgrounds (F & G Loops, Campsite #'s 200-280) offer premium full hookup 50 amp sites'; 'ADA-accessible campsites (Sites 236 and 280)') + cpwshop catalog (F/G Full Hookup: maximum vehicle length 38-90, Driveway Entry Pull-Through), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Closed in winter: only select Elk Ridge and Dakota Terraces sites stay open then. The booking site opens the F loop for 2027 on April 1 (site 200 is unavailable through March).

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging ('Embrace the serene beauty of winter by camping in select campsites in Elk Ridge and Dakota Terraces campgrounds') + cpwshop availability grid (site 200HA: X Nov 2026-Mar 28 2027, available from 04/01/2027), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging (Pa-Co-Chu-Puk: 'Individual 50 amp electrical hook ups', 'Individual water hook-ups', 'Individual sewer dump'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Camper service building with free showers and flush restrooms; coin laundry and vending summer only. Playgrounds, fishing access, trails.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging (Pa-Co-Chu-Puk: 'a modern camper service building with showers, flush restrooms, and seasonal laundry facilities'; 'Free showers'; 'Coin-operated laundry facilities (summer only)'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reservation required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; ADA sites by phone only, with a placard. A daily vehicle pass is required as well. Check-in 1 p.m. (no early check-in), check-out noon; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Ridgway State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. ADA designated campsites ... must be reserved by phone'; 'Reservations can be made up to six months in advance of your arrival date'; 'Check-in time for your site is at 1:00 p.m. ... check-out is by 12:00 p.m. (noon)'), read 2026-10-27

note: Campground on the Uncompahgre River below the Ridgway dam (gold-medal trout water); loops F and G. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop: confirmed 50-amp full hookups, 81 sites (200-280), $41, reservation-only. Changed season year_round true -> false (CPW: winter camping only in Elk Ridge and Dakota Terraces). Added max rig 90, pull-through, showers/flush toilets/laundry/potable water, booking url/window/note.
flags: Amperage conflict: CPW says individual 50-amp hookups in both F and G loops; cpwshop's rate records show 'Electricity Hookup 50' for F-loop sites but '30' for G-loop sites (237HA etc.). Recorded 50 from CPW.
Site-count: CPW gives site numbers 200-280 (81); cpwshop holds 78 full-hookup sites (F 35, G 43). Kept 81.
Season dates are not published; the 2027 calendar opens the F loop April 1, and the fall close is not visible now (it is closed already). Closed now for the season.
Pin checked: ~80 m from the centroid of the 80 F/G-loop cpwshop site coordinates (38.24803,-107.76268).
